description: Gemwing Dragon default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/gemwing_dragon-character-sheet.png (the intake found no chips; the chip row y 852 sampled directly, r 10 px medians: x 1310 241,221,215 pearl / x 1368 126,128,190 muted periwinkle / x 1427 85,87,166 muted indigo / x 1488 79,147,253 blue / x 1548 166,112,253 violet / x 1610 253,185,111 peach-orange) + direct samples of the drawn surfaces (px cited per region). ARTIST DIRECTION 2026-10-11: 'tone the crystalness of the body and save the most color for the wings and spikes around it' -> the BODY regions (body_*) take only the sheet's LOW-saturation body tones (pearl / soft periwinkle, sat <= 0.36), with two sparse muted accents; the WINGS + SPIKES (gem_*) take the saturated prismatic tones (sat 0.36-0.76). Matte-satin, opaque (no translucency), no glow (the sheet's sheen is colour, not light): every region writes zero Glow.
